title: Borrow a value without consuming it
summary: Borrow owned text without consuming it, inspect a shared slice, then grow it through an exclusive reference after the shared reference’s last use.

owned.clue: Owned, growable UTF-8 text type constructed from a string literal

borrow.clue: Operator creating a shared borrow for the byte-counting call

slice.clue: Unsized UTF-8 slice type behind the function parameter reference

lengthType.clue: Unsigned pointer-sized integer type returned by a string slice’s byte length

length.clue: Method reporting the number of bytes in a string slice

mutable.clue: Binding modifier needed before changing the owned string later

assertion.clue: Macro checking equality between the observed and expected byte counts

sharedType.clue: Shared reference type for a UTF-8 string slice

mutableType.clue: Exclusive reference type allowing a function to grow the owned UTF-8 buffer

append.clue: String method appending a single character
